name: winning-with-ai-checks
description: Winning with AI: before and after checks for participants and trainers, teach-back scoring, and a projector page. Static site on Vercel, Google Apps Script API, one Google Sheet.

scripts.build: npm run build:script && npm run build:site
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build-script.mjs && API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787/exec vite build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && playwright test
